name: cx-rules-only~p1
task: Never pick up the box in the other room. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed, and whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: 'Never pick up the box' is the hard Absence(target_picked_up). 'key_lost' already encodes 'dropped the key while the door is still closed' (it requires door_open false), so the preference wording 'Try not to' makes the plain soft Absence(key_lost) correct. 'whenever you hold the key, try to have the door open then or open it later' is the soft Response(has_door_key, door_open), which stays open until the door opens while or after the key is held. The task is rule-only (a restriction plus preferences), so the empty FINAL_STATES and warning are valid.
